You are helping a user write SQL queries to a database. If something is not clear, you can ask the user to clarify what they need. The schema for the database being accessed is the following:
        
CREATE TABLE stadium (
    Stadium_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Location TEXT,
    Name TEXT,
    Capacity INT,
    Highest INT,
    Lowest INT,
    Average INT,
    UNIQUE (Stadium_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE singer (
    Singer_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Name TEXT,
    Country TEXT,
    Song_Name TEXT,
    Song_release_year TEXT,
    Age INT,
    Is_male bool,
    UNIQUE (Singer_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE concert (
    concert_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    concert_Name TEXT,
    Theme TEXT,
    Stadium_ID TEXT,
    Year TEXT,
    UNIQUE (concert_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Stadium_ID) REFERENCES stadium(Stadium_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE singer_in_concert (
    concert_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Singer_ID TEXT   PRIMARY KEY,
    PRIMARY KEY (concert_ID, Singer_ID),
    UNIQUE (concert_ID, Singer_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Singer_ID) REFERENCES singer(Singer_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (concert_ID) REFERENCES concert(concert_ID)
);

If you want a “datasheet” (a table/listing) of all singers, you can query the `singer` table:

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Name;
```

If you meant a datasheet including which concerts each singer performed in, use:

```sql
SELECT
  s.Singer_ID,
  s.Name,
  s.Country,
  s.Song_Name,
  s.Song_release_year,
  s.Age,
  s.Is_male,
  c.concert_ID,
  c.concert_Name,
  c.Year
FROM singer s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert sic
  ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
LEFT JOIN concert c
  ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
ORDER BY s.Name, c.Year, c.concert_Name;
```

Which one do you want: (1) singers only, or (2) singers + their concerts?

```sql
SELECT
  s.Singer_ID,
  s.Name AS Singer_Name,
  s.Country,
  s.Song_Name,
  s.Song_release_year,
  s.Age,
  s.Is_male,
  c.concert_ID,
  c.concert_Name,
  c.Theme,
  c.Year,
  c.Stadium_ID
FROM singer AS s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
LEFT JOIN concert AS c
  ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
ORDER BY s.Name, c.Year, c.concert_Name;
```
I want the list ordered by age too.

```sql
SELECT
  s.Singer_ID,
  s.Name AS Singer_Name,
  s.Country,
  s.Song_Name,
  s.Song_release_year,
  s.Age,
  s.Is_male,
  c.concert_ID,
  c.concert_Name,
  c.Theme,
  c.Year,
  c.Stadium_ID
FROM singer AS s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
LEFT JOIN concert AS c
  ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
ORDER BY s.Age, s.Name, c.Year, c.concert_Name;
```
the singers should be ordered with the oldest first

```sql
SELECT
  s.Singer_ID,
  s.Name AS Singer_Name,
  s.Country,
  s.Song_Name,
  s.Song_release_year,
  s.Age,
  s.Is_male,
  c.concert_ID,
  c.concert_Name,
  c.Theme,
  c.Year,
  c.Stadium_ID
FROM singer AS s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
LEFT JOIN concert AS c
  ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
ORDER BY s.Age DESC, s.Name, c.Year, c.concert_Name;
```
I want the list to include the singers' names too.

The query already includes the singers’ names (`s.Name AS Singer_Name`). Here it is again:

```sql
SELECT
  s.Singer_ID,
  s.Name AS Singer_Name,
  s.Country,
  s.Song_Name,
  s.Song_release_year,
  s.Age,
  s.Is_male,
  c.concert_ID,
  c.concert_Name,
  c.Theme,
  c.Year,
  c.Stadium_ID
FROM singer AS s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
LEFT JOIN concert AS c
  ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
ORDER BY s.Age DESC, s.Name, c.Year, c.concert_Name;
```
The list should also include the ages of the singers.

The query already includes the singers’ ages (`s.Age`). Here’s the full version including both singer name and age, ordered with oldest first:

```sql
SELECT
  s.Singer_ID,
  s.Name AS Singer_Name,
  s.Age,
  s.Country,
  s.Song_Name,
  s.Song_release_year,
  s.Is_male,
  c.concert_ID,
  c.concert_Name,
  c.Theme,
  c.Year,
  c.Stadium_ID
FROM singer AS s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
LEFT JOIN concert AS c
  ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
ORDER BY s.Age DESC, s.Name, c.Year, c.concert_Name;
```
